moat_against: Core domains are a near-commodity: Namecheap, Cloudflare (at-cost), Porkbun and Dynadot undercut GoDaddy's ~$20-22 .com renewals
Low technical switching costs — a domain transfer is a standardised ICANN process; retention rests on inertia and bundling, not lock-in
Core Platform growth is only low-single-digit (Q2 2026 +4%); the .CO registry contract expiration is a >200bp cumulative revenue headwind in the FY26 guide
Renewal-price and upsell reputation invites churn and regulatory / consumer-protection scrutiny

Bookings decelerated to +5% in Q4 2025 on a $4.99 promotional offer that contradicted the stated high-intent strategy — now the subject of a securities class action (Johnson v. GoDaddy, 26-cv-7144, SDNY)
moat_for: Largest registrar by scale — ~10.8% share of registrations vs ~3.5% for the next rival (Namecheap) per 2026 registrar comparisons, with the widest TLD selection
Durable subscription renewal base: primary domains revenue ~$1.8B annualised, growing ~5-6% CAGR, paid upfront (deferred revenue funds the model)
Attach economics: domains funnel into Applications & Commerce, which grew +11% in Q2 2026 (Airo AI builder bookings run-rate 5x to $50M in one quarter)
ROIC proxy (fundamentals.json) rose from 9.2% (2020) to 33.2% (FY2025) and operating margin from 8.2% to 22.8% (24.8% TTM) — returns now well above cost of capital and still expanding
Capital return as a per-share engine: >95% of FCF to buybacks over the last 4 years, diluted shares down ~31% since 2022 and -11% YoY in Q2 2026
moat_justification: Moderate-strong (6/10): scale, brand and a paid-upfront renewal base plus A&C attach give real durability, and the ROIC history now supports it — roic_proxy in fundamentals.json rose 9.2% (2020), 13.5% (2021), 18.1% (2022), 12.6% (2023), 20.8% (2024), 33.2% (FY2025), with operating margin expanding 8.2% to 22.8%. It is not a 7+: the core product is price-transparent and transferable, cheaper rivals are credible, and Core Platform growth is low-single-digit. Gross margin is not quoted because fundamentals.json carries no COGS/gross-profit series for the recent fiscal years (the field is null there) — operating margin and ROIC are the margin evidence available in the computed outputs.
name: GoDaddy Inc.
one_liner: Durable registrar cash machine, moat 6/10 — clears 15% on the TTM base (17.8% weighted IRR, IV@15% $133.61 vs $105.96 price) but the bear-to-bull band spans C to A, so size it to the bear end; it would need to fall to ~$91.21 to clear 20%.
